title: Jet Express
specs: Minors traveling aboard the Jet Express must be accompanied by an adult.
Must be 21 or older to rent golf carts.
The registered Passholder who bought a Season Parking Pass must be present in the vehicle.
Parking passes must be redeemed for a card at the Port Clinton ticket office.
The registered Passholder who bought a Bike Pass must be present with the bike.
Bike passes must be redeemed for a tag that is put on your bike at the dock they are leaving from each time.
The name listed on your credit card must be identical to the contact name listed on your booking.

quotes.author: Gerald E. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: It was amazing. Staff knew American Sign Language to communicate with the four Deaf of us, including safety procedures, checked to ensure we knew what to do, and asked if we needed anything when we arrived at Put-In-Bay. The rest of the staff were friendly and had incredible hospitality.

quotes.author: Steve C. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: The Jet Express….prompt, reliable and most of all enjoyable. We had a smooth ride from Sandusky over to Put in Bay on the catamaran….so sorry time did not permit us to also take a trip with you to Kelly’s Island, but who knows, maybe next time.

quotes.author: Bill H. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: We had a great experience using Jet Express, we were able to make reservations that fit our needs for my wife and I taking three of my grandkids to Put In Bay for the Independence Day festivities. The service over and back was top notch!!

quotes.author: AMY • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Great way to get to Put n Bay. It is great that they drop you off right in town. The staff if friendly. Enjoyed the ride. We were able to change our return trip to a later time. I recommend taking the Jet Express.
